tool.name: PRINSEQ Analysis
tool.description: Quality control checks on raw sequence data.
tool.command:
#if $input_files.single_or_collection.input_single_or_collection == "single" #if $input_files.single_or_collection.query.ext.startswith('fasta') #set $format = 'fasta' #else #set $format = 'fastq' #end if ln -s '$input_files.single_or_collection.query' 'input.$format' && #elif $input_files.single_or_collection.input_single_or_collection == "collection" ## PRINSEQ reports on one file, so join the collection into one file. #set $formats = [] #for $file in $input_files.single_or_collection.query #if $file.ext.startswith('fasta') #silent $formats.append('fasta') #else #silent $formats.append('fastq') #end if #end for #if 'fasta' in $formats and 'fastq' in $formats echo 'The collection mixes FASTQ and FASTA files. Use one format.' >&2; exit 1; #end if #set $format = $formats[0] cat #for $file in $input_files.single_or_collection.query '$file' #end for > 'input.$format' && #end if
prinseq-lite.pl -$format 'input.$format' -out_good null -out_bad null -graph_data graph-data.txt && prinseq-graphs-noPCA.pl -i graph-data.txt -html_all -o report

param.name: input_single_or_collection
param.label: Input single file or collection
param.help: Choose whether to check a single file or one combined report for every file of a collection (default = single)
param.option: collection of FASTQ or FASTA files

param.name: query
param.label: FASTQ or FASTA files
param.help: A list collection of reads, joined into one file before the analysis. Use only FASTQ files or only FASTA files

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark See PRINSEQ documentation: https://prinseq.sourceforge.net/manual.html for full software details.
**What it does** Runs quality control checks on FASTQ or FASTA reads, and writes an HTML report with summary graphs and tables.
For a list collection, the tool joins all files into one first and makes one combined report. To get one report for every file instead, select the files one by one in batch mode.
